payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Create a neumorphic UI with soft 3D effects. Use light pastels, rounded corners (12-16px), subtle soft shadows (multiple layers), no hard lines, monochromatic color scheme with light/dark variations. Embossed/debossed effect on interactive elements.
payload.best_for: Health/wellness apps, meditation platforms, fitness trackers, minimal interaction UIs
payload.css_technical_keywords: border-radius: 12-16px, box-shadow: -5px -5px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.1), 5px 5px 15px rgba(255,255,255,0.8), background: linear-gradient(145deg, color1, color2), transform: scale on press
payload.do_not_use_for: Complex apps, critical accessibility, data-heavy dashboards, high-contrast required
payload.effects_and_animation: Soft box-shadow (multiple: -5px -5px 15px, 5px 5px 15px), smooth press (150ms), inner subtle shadow
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Rounded corners 12-16px consistent, ☐ Multiple shadow layers (2-3), ☐ Pastel color verified, ☐ Monochromatic palette checked, ☐ Press animation smooth 150ms
payload.keywords: Soft UI, embossed, debossed, convex, concave, light source, subtle depth, rounded (12-16px), monochromatic
payload.primary_colors: Light pastels: Soft Blue #C8E0F4, Soft Pink #F5E0E8, Soft Grey #E8E8E8
